newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Garment maker Chaifa appoints executives.
newsitem.headline: Garment maker Chaifa appoints executives.

text.p: Chaifa Holdings Ltd said on Sunday it had appointed Ma Ching-Nam as a non-executive director and Jacky Chan Chun Nam as general manager of the China division of the company.
Ma, who is a solicitor by profession, is also a director of Tai Sang Bank, Chaifa said in a statement.
Chan is deputy chairman of the group.
Assistant general manager Patrick Choi Wai Kit, who is also an executive director, was promoted to general manager, it said.

Chaifa holds the exclusive licences to design, manufacture, sell and distribute a wide range of garments under the Playboy and Garfield brandnames in Hong Kong, Macau and China, and under the Arnold Palmer brandname in China.
